title: Customs Tariff Amendment (Peru-Australia Free Trade Agreement Implementation) Bill 2018
short_title: Customs Tariff Amendment (Peru-Australia Free Trade Agreement Implementation) Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: This bill would change the Customs Tariff Act 1995 to put the Peru-Australia Free Trade Agreement into effect.
It would set lower customs duty rates for goods from Peru that meet new origin rules, and add a new schedule for excise-equivalent rates on alcohol, tobacco, fuel and petroleum products.
The 2018-19 Budget estimated the cost to revenue over the forward estimates would be negligible, rounded to zero.
changes: Provides preferential customs duty rates for Peruvian originating goods.
Inserts new Schedule 6A for excise-equivalent rates on certain alcohol, tobacco, fuel and petroleum products.
Amends concessional items in Schedule 4 to maintain duty rates in line with PAFTA.
summary.affected: Importers of goods from Peru and the Department of Home Affairs.
